description: Aquarius Writer's main window and its popouts. Deliberately narrow: the vault is reached through this app's own commands (which need no permission and do their own path checks), so the only plugin permissions granted are the folder picker, the four window-chrome actions our own title bar performs, and the one call that opens a popout window (⌃⌘O). The AquariusOS updater added in v0.2.0 needs nothing here either — its four commands are our own, and the `updater://state` event it emits is covered by the listener permission inside `core:default`.
